evidence.locator: public artifact installation and acceptance contract

scenarioCoverage.expected: All release stages consume one plan digest and source identity.
scenarioCoverage.scenario: normal release uses one immutable typed plan
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run Rust resolver, workflow policy, and hosted release checks.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Historical recovery is accepted only with tag/source and archived recovery bindings.
scenarioCoverage.scenario: historical tag recovery requires bound archived evidence
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run resolver fixtures for valid, missing, foreign, stale, and contradictory recovery evidence.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Post-release acceptance cannot rebuild or publish and consumes the plan artifact.
scenarioCoverage.scenario: post release acceptance reuses published identity
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run post-release workflow policy and receipt reuse fixtures.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Close-only validates prior acceptance receipts and cannot publish or create a new prerequisite.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run close-only transition and fixed-point fixtures.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Downstream jobs reject a missing, stale, or mismatched plan digest instead of re-inferring mode.
scenarioCoverage.scenario: raw workflow inputs cannot diverge after plan generation
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run workflow static policy and plan digest tamper fixtures.

scenarioCoverage.expected: The existing tag, release, and archived evidence are not rewritten.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Compare immutable release and archive digests before and after focused verification.

scenarioCoverage.expected: NormalRelease, HistoricalTagRecovery, PostReleaseAcceptance, CloseOnly, and IndependentPublicAcceptance have explicit allowed transitions.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Exercise the typed plan transition matrix before any publication run.
